mechanism: Both drugs are metabolized by hepatic CYP450 enzymes (mefloquine by CYP3A4 and clotrimazole as a CYP3A4 inhibitor), potentially increasing mefloquine levels and CNS toxicity risk.
action: Monitor for mefloquine neurotoxicity symptoms (dizziness, neuropsychiatric effects); consider alternative antifungal if possible or adjust mefloquine dosing.
